title: Chapter 313
text:
When the fleet stopped, there was already a sea of players watching from afar. They watched as the fleet unloaded boxes of supplies on the empty ground, piling them up like a small mountain. A group of chosen pro players waited on the side in twos and threes.

Han Xiao, who attracted the most attention, was standing alone on the side, looking up at the sky as if he was waiting for something.

Many players turned on the video function excitedly.

"So, he's leaving today."

Everyone was curious about how Han Xiao was going to leave Blue Star. The players had been waiting for this for a long time. They all looked up at the sky with curiosity.

It was dawn. The sun was slowly rising from the horizon. The sky was getting brighter and brighter, and the darkness was gradually dispelled.

At this time, a black shadow the size of an ant suddenly appeared in the sky above the crowd. Only when they focused their eyes could they see that it was the outline of a spaceship that was slowly descending.

"Look, a spaceship!"

At first, the crowd was still discussing in amazement. However, as the shadow of the spaceship grew larger and larger in everyone's sight, the voices of discussion gradually died down. The noisy scene suddenly became dead silent.

Tens of thousands of people opened their mouths wide. They were all speechless by the scene in front of them!

When the spaceship was still high in the sky, its outline was only the size of a green bean. When it was a few hundred meters above the crowd, they realized that this spaceship was terrifyingly huge. Its mountain-sized shadow covered the sky silently above everyone's head, covering the sun and the sky!

"Oh my god … How big is this spaceship?"

Looking up from the ground, their vision was completely blocked by the spaceship. It was pitch black, and they could not see the end of it. Only the outline of the spaceship could be seen. The moment Short Horn Star landed, a poem appeared in everyone's mind.

Dark clouds loomed over the city, threatening to destroy it.

Short Horn Star, the main ship of the tour group, was a large travel spaceship with its own ecosystem. It could even be used as a mobile space station for long-distance travel in the universe. It was surrounded by probe devices and patrol defense cannons, as well as high-energy convergent shields. Just this large main ship alone could traverse the entire Blue Star.

The crowd was so shocked, not to mention the chosen pro players. They all gasped. In their eyes, Han Xiao was only a Blue Star character. It was unbelievable that he could summon such a large spaceship.

However, Han Xiao had displayed his remarkable abilities, and this group of teammates had also gained a lot of confidence.

This scene was too impactful. It was filled with a sci-fi aesthetic. The mechanical monster and the environment had reached a perfect harmony. It had the qualifications to become a desktop wallpaper. The players fought to be the first to take photos and videos.

A box-shaped floating cabin was detached from Short Horn Star. Four jets were spitting out blue exhaust flames. It slowly landed in front of Han Xiao, kicking up a cloud of dust. This was an airdrop cabin designed to receive passengers on the ground. It was full of mechanical style and had a precise structure. It was all metal and pure mechanical technology.

The cabin door opened, and the foldable gangway extended in front of Han Xiao.

"Let's get on the boat. I can't wait to have a drink." Kerlodd couldn't wait to get on the boat, completely forgetting that he was no longer in charge of his savings.

Han Xiao asked the players to be the coolies. They carried all the resource boxes up and then stepped into the airdrop pod. The pod door closed automatically, and the airdrop pod took off vertically, embedding itself in Short Horn Star.

Then, Short Horn Star rose rapidly. Such a huge spaceship was flying silently, and there was no tail flame. It gave everyone a strong feeling of contrast. When the spaceship docked at the planet, it turned off its engine and only turned on its anti-gravity core to save fuel.

Through the window, Han Xiao looked at the crowd that was slowly turning into ants and sighed in relief. "I've finally taken this step after being in Blue Star for so long."

The sky was high and the sea was wide.

On the flat ground, countless players watched the spaceship disappear into the sky. The sun shone down again.

…

Inside Sanctuary Three, Hella stood behind her sister. She put her hands on Aurora's shoulders. The two of them looked up at the Short Horn Star that was descending.

"Will he come back?" Aurora asked curiously.

Hella was silent for a while. She shook her head slowly. "That's a wider world. Why would he come back when he's already out there?"

"Sis, why don't we go with him?"

Hella rubbed Aurora's light blonde hair and didn't say anything.

"… Sis, you're hurting me."

Hella then realized that she had used too much strength. She immediately slowed down.

The bear cub beside her roared at the sky a few times. It then laid on the ground and buried its head in its paws. It raised its butt and whimpered as if it was sad that its owner had left it.

Aurora rubbed the soft fur of the bear. She was depressed. "Will we see him again?" she asked softly.

"We will meet again sooner or later."

"But you just said that he won't come back."

"Yeah." Hella didn't explain further. Aurora understood what Hella was trying to say. Her eyes lit up, and she was excited again.

…

"He's gone."

In Sanctuary One, Bennett was video-chatting with Huang Yu. He was listening to Huang Yu's report.

"I'll leave Sanctuary Three to you from now on. Don't change Han Xiao's measures. Other than that, you can decide on everything else yourself."

"Okay. Thank you, Mr. Bennett." Huang Yu was excited. After working as a laborer for so long, he finally got the chance.

"Don't thank me. It was Han Xiao who recommended you before he left."

"I understand." Huang Yu nodded heavily and remembered it in his heart.

After ending the call, Bennett opened his secret account and clicked on the ultimatum that the Six Nations had sent a few days ago.

Raylan had joined forces with other countries to pressure the Dark Net. Bennett suppressed this himself. He didn't want Han Xiao to be troubled by this before he left.

But now, what was done was done. The way his old friend left was enough to shock the Six Nations. Even he was shocked. Bennett was very curious about how Raylan felt right now.

…

There were too many witnesses to this incident, and it had a huge impact on the world. The video quickly spread on the Internet. The people of Blue Star witnessed the scene of a mountain-sized spaceship landing on the planet. It was very shocking.

Short Horn Star was so huge that it didn't hide at all when it landed, which shocked the Six Nations. When the satellites discovered Short Horn Star, the Six Nations panicked and were about to send out their air force to negotiate. However, Short Horn Star had no intention of negotiating with the government of the planet. Before the Six Nations could do anything, it just left.

Blue Star was visited by such a huge spaceship, and the Six Nations were very worried. They hurriedly tried to find out the details.

When they found out the truth, that Short Horn Star had only landed to pick up Han Xiao, the Six Nations' confusion instantly turned into shock!

A mysterious giant spaceship that was countless years ahead of the Blue Star civilization level was actually here for Black Phantom?

How did he do it? What other secrets was he hiding?

Even if they knew that Black Phantom was very powerful, this was too shocking! It was beyond everyone's imagination!
